question.question: Does Status preserve the active automatic-transition flag when it clones a legally installed implicit joint configuration?
question.importance: Callers may misinterpret current configuration as requiring manual exit. This is configuration-reporting fidelity; mutation of live consensus state is not assumed.
contexts: Implicit joint configuration installed by ApplyConfChange
event_paths: Commit implicit joint entry -> apply configuration -> request Status -> complete Ready

supporting_behavior_ids.B-application: Ordinary caller processing installs the joint state before acknowledging its batch.

counterevidence: The active configuration retains AutoLeave and automatic exit may still occur.
ConfChange Changer also uses Clone, but EnterJoint explicitly sets AutoLeave and LeaveJoint clears it; do not infer protocol mutation from the export defect.
question.trigger_rationale: Clone explicitly promises a copy yet omits a boolean in its returned literal; getStatus uses that result as the current configuration. A fixed public Status observation after actual application separates value-copy failure from stale caller data.

obligation.description: A Status snapshot of the current Raft configuration must preserve the active Config.AutoLeave value. Config.Clone must copy that value along with the membership sets rather than reporting a default value unrelated to the source configuration.

scope.description: Value fidelity of AutoLeave in a serialized Status snapshot of a legally installed implicit joint configuration.
assumptions: Caller owns RawNode serially and uses normal persisted, applied, then Advanced Ready handling.
Observation occurs after ApplyConfChange and before further protocol mutation.
excluded: Status.MarshalJSON representation, which does not include configuration.
Live state mutation or quorum/safety failure.
Caller reliance on the flag for a particular external action.

grounding.derivation: Config.Clone promises a copy of Config without shared memory, and RawNode.Status promises current status. AutoLeave is an explicit Config field encoding transition ownership. Omitting it violates value-copy fidelity when the source is true; this local contract does not require a downstream failure.
grounding.applicability: A true flag is established by an actual implicit joint ApplyConfChange, then read synchronously without intervening state transition.
alternatives: Map fields are correctly deep-copied; that does not preserve an omitted scalar.

bindings.description: Copies active Config through Config.Clone when returning Status.

associations.rationale: Public current-status and copy contracts apply to this returned Config.

remaining: Fix and execute the independent Status fidelity check; no result is transferred from the prior obligation.
